source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: 30 points. Bearer must be a KÂHL model. During the Fight phase, whenever one of the models of the bearer's unit is destroyed while that unit has not yet been picked to fight in the phase, roll a D6; a result of 4+ means the model stays on the battlefield until the unit has fought or the phase is over, whichever comes sooner, and is then removed.

effects.trigger: model in the bearer's unit destroyed
effects.condition: unit not yet selected to fight this phase
effects.removedAt: after this unit has fought or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first
